# Configuration

Everything is set with environment variables: in Portainer under the stack's
*Environment variables*, with the docker compose CLI in `.env` (copy
[`.env.example`](../.env.example)). `docker-compose.yml` passes the variables
marked *compose* on to the container; the others keep their default unless
you add them to `docker-compose.yml` yourself.

## Proxy

The `estyma-proxy` service, default command of the image.

| Variable | Default | Compose | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UPSTREAM` | (empty) |  | Provider server the requests are forwarded to, e.g. `http://203.0.113.10:80`. Required unless `MODE=local` without `CLOUD_MIRROR` / `LOCAL_FALLBACK` (set directly in `docker-compose.yml`) |
| `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` | `30` |  | Seconds to wait for the provider before answering `502` (set directly in `docker-compose.yml`) |
| `LISTEN_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` |  | Bind address inside the container |
| `LISTEN_PORT` | `80` |  | Proxy port inside the container (the host port is `PROXY_PORT`) |
| `LOG_DIR` | `/logs` |  | Where the logs and state files are written (the `estyma-logs` volume) |
| `MAX_BODY_LOG` | `0` |  | Max bytes of each body kept in the log, `0` = unlimited |
| `UI_PORT` | `8089` | yes | Web UI port. Inside the container `0` turns the UI off; in `docker-compose.yml` it is the host port (inside it stays 8089) |
| `UI_USER` | (empty) | yes | Basic auth user for the web UI. Also needed for writes, switching cloud monitoring and deleting logs |
| `UI_PASSWORD` | (empty) | yes | Basic auth password; auth is on only when user and password are both set |
| `LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` | `0` | yes | Delete `.jsonl` logs older than this many days, `0` = keep them all. Only the initial state: once it is changed on the settings page, the page's choice is kept in `log-retention.json` |
| `MONITOR_HISTORY_HOURS` | `48` |  | Hours of decoded values the monitor keeps in memory for its charts (reloaded from the logs on start) |

## Local server

Same service, see [operating-modes.md](operating-modes.md).

| Variable | Default | Compose | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MODE` | `proxy` | yes | `proxy`, `hybrid` or `local` |
| `WRITES_ENABLED` | `0` | yes | `1` = allow local writes (boiler target) |
| `ALLOW_POWER_WRITES` | `0` | yes | `1` = also allow switching the boiler on/off; needs `WRITES_ENABLED=1` |
| `ALLOW_UNTESTED_WRITES` | `0` | yes | `1` = also allow the settings whose write path is untested (all but boiler target and on/off); needs `WRITES_ENABLED=1` |
| `SETTINGS_READ_MINUTES` | `60` | yes | Minutes between reads of all settings in `hybrid`/`local`, `0` = only on start and on request |
| `WRITE_TIMEOUT` | `120` |  | Seconds until a write without read-back is marked failed |
| `WRITE_MIN_INTERVAL` | `10` |  | Minimum seconds between two requests for the same register |
| `LOCAL_FALLBACK` | `0` | yes | `1` = in `proxy`/`hybrid`, answer locally when the cloud fails instead of `502` |
| `CLOUD_MIRROR` | `0` | yes | `1` = in `local`, still forward each report to the cloud and ignore its reply |
| `CONTROLLER_TZ` | `Europe/Warsaw` | yes | Time zone of the controller clock, for the clock sync in `local` mode |
| `CLOCK_SYNC_HOURS` | `6` |  | Hours between clock syncs in `local` mode, `0` = off |
| `POLL_DELAY` | `10` |  | `DELAY` value in local replies (the controller's pause between polls) |
| `STATE_FILE` | (empty) |  | Last reported registers and the learned register list, kept across restarts; empty = `state.json` in `LOG_DIR` |

## Cloud monitoring

Same service, see [cloud-monitoring.md](cloud-monitoring.md).

| Variable | Default | Compose | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ESTYMA_EMAIL` | (empty) | yes | Login e-mail of your Estyma cloud account; without it cloud monitoring is unavailable |
| `ESTYMA_PASSWORD` | (empty) | yes | Password of that account |
| `ESTYMA_PASSWORD_B64` | (empty) | yes | Base64 of the password, overrides `ESTYMA_PASSWORD`. Use it when the password starts or ends with a space, because `.env` files and some UIs trim those (`printf ' my password' \| base64`) |
| `ESTYMA_PASSWORD_FILE` | (empty) |  | Path to a file holding the password (e.g. a Docker secret); only a trailing newline is removed |
| `ESTYMA_DOMAIN` | `igneo.pl` |  | Which Estyma cloud to log in to |
| `ESTYMA_LANGUAGE` | `english` |  | Language for the wrapper's value names |
| `CLOUD_MONITOR` | `0` | yes | Initial on/off state, only used until it is switched in the web UI |
| `CLOUD_INTERVAL` | `30` | yes | Seconds between cloud polls |

## MQTT / Home Assistant

Same service, see [home-assistant.md](home-assistant.md).

| Variable | Default | Compose | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MQTT_HOST` | (empty) | yes | Broker host name or IP; empty = publisher off |
| `MQTT_PORT` | `1883` | yes | Broker port. Without compose it defaults to `8883` with `MQTT_TLS=1`; compose always passes `1883`, so set `8883` there for TLS |
| `MQTT_USER` | (empty) | yes | Broker login, if needed |
| `MQTT_PASSWORD` | (empty) | yes | Broker password, if needed |
| `MQTT_TLS` | `0` | yes | `1` = connect with TLS (system CA certificates) |
| `MQTT_PREFIX` | `estyma` | yes | First part of the topics |
| `MQTT_DEVICE_ID` | `boiler` | yes | Second part of the topics and of the unique IDs; change only for a second boiler |
| `HA_DISCOVERY_PREFIX` | `homeassistant` | yes | Home Assistant's discovery prefix |
| `MQTT_STALE_SECONDS` | `300` | yes | Seconds without a controller report until the device is unavailable. Keep it well above 100 s: after a slow or failed cloud reply the controller waits about 100 s before its next report |
| `FUEL_KWH_PER_KG` | (empty) | yes | Calorific value for the energy sensor; empty = controller setting, else 4.8 |

## Standalone cloud recorder

`python3 -m estyma_local.cloud_recorder` reads the same `ESTYMA_*` variables as cloud monitoring, plus these.

| Variable | Default | Compose | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INTERVAL` | `30` |  | Seconds between polls |
| `IDLE_IF_UNCONFIGURED` | (empty) |  | `1` = idle instead of exiting without credentials |

## Compose / `.env` (host side)

Only used by `docker-compose.yml`, not inside the container.

| Variable | Default | Compose | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PROXY_PORT` | `8088` | yes | Host port of the proxy; the router's DNAT rule points here |
